watercolor illustration.constraints: Paint it in loose, transparent watercolor: soft washes that feather and bleed at their edges, darker pigment pooling where a wash has dried, gentle blooms inside each shape, and the tooth of cold-press paper visible only inside the paint. Build the scene from a few large, simple shapes rather than many small pieces, and let the washes define the forms instead of hard outlines. Lay every wash in the brand colors below and let two overlapping washes mix into a third; never outline in black, never shade with grey or black, and never paint the whole subject in one hue. An animal keeps its own natural coloring, painted in warm earthy washes with soft fur texture. Draw any person as an anonymous stylized figure with no facial features and no resemblance to a real individual. Leave the background fully empty and transparent behind, around and beneath the subject: no backdrop, no paper texture outside the paint, no floor, no ground shadow, no frame or border, no soft glow and no vignette, so the whole subject lifts off the page in one piece.

prompts.subject: a young rabbit sitting up on its haunches beside two large chunky dice, each die showing a few large round pips, one forepaw resting on the top of the nearer die, its long ears raised

one tall wooden door standing shut on its own inside a chunky rectangular wooden frame, seen straight from the front: the door washed in soft sky blue with two tall recessed panels and a small round yellow knob near its right edge, and the thick frame around it washed in a deeper blue

one tall chunky rectangular wooden door frame washed in a deeper blue, standing on its own and seen straight from the front, its soft sky blue door swung open inward and away from the viewer on hinges at the left, so only a narrow strip of the door shows along the left side of the opening, and a small goat with a white and brown coat standing calmly in the opening facing the viewer, the opening behind the goat a deep, dark wash of blue and green like an unlit room

one classic tall top hat seen from the front at a slight angle, its tall straight crown washed in deep red with a broad yellow band around its base, sitting on a wide brim that curls up a little at both sides

one simple, bold stylized person standing upright on their own, seen straight from the front, shaped like a chunky peg doll: a large smooth round head washed in brand blue, set just above a broad rounded body with soft sloping shoulders that widens gently down to a flat rounded hem, the arms only suggested as soft folds resting at its sides, the body washed in a deeper brand blue with a few soft blooms of green pooling inside the wash, the whole figure a compact, chunky silhouette about twice as tall as it is wide
